content:
This month, Apple will release its first foldable iPhone—reportedly named the iPhone Ultra. The device will feature a 5.5-inch outer display and a 7.6-inch inner display. Samsung got ahead of the curve in July by launching its next-generation Galaxy Z Fold 8, and the two devices have identical screen sizes.

Whether you believe Samsung released this device just to beat the iPhone Ultra to market is another story—but either way, getting eyes on the Galaxy Z Fold 8 gives us an early look at what the iPhone Ultra will actually feel like in the real world.

Reviewers who got their hands on the Galaxy Z Fold 8 early have been posting plenty of comparison shots on Twitter with other devices. Since the iPhone Ultra is close in size to the Galaxy Z Fold 8, these images give us a preview of what the iPhone Ultra will look like and how it'll actually feel.

Ray Wong posted several shots of the Galaxy Z Fold 8 alongside the previous-generation iPad mini, highlighting that you really can get an iPad mini-like screen experience on a foldable—just without the chunky bezels.

Additionally, enthusiast Shishir shared images comparing the iPhone 13 mini with the Galaxy Z Fold 8. The iPhone 13 mini is slightly taller than this foldable, but the two are similarly sized. For anyone mourning the iPhone mini lineup, the iPhone Ultra might just bring back that feeling.

Personally, after seeing the Galaxy Z Fold 8 last week, my anticipation for the iPhone Ultra is even stronger than before. The two devices should look nearly identical (though the iPhone Ultra will feature rounded corners)—so until Apple officially unveils it in September, the Galaxy Z Fold 8 might genuinely be our best reference for previewing Apple's next big thing.

Of course, you can also check out dummy model images for further comparison.
